_comment: Composer's LISTENING verdicts. The analyzer measures; only the composer can say whether a bent sample sounds like a tuba. Kept in its own file because analyze_bend_probe.py regenerates docs/MORPH_FINDINGS.md wholesale, and a hand-typed verdict in that file would be silently destroyed by the next run.

glissViability.verdict: No artifact limit found anywhere inside the patch's +/-2 semitone bend range.
glissViability.composerWords: They all sound fine and natural.
glissViability.caveat: Tested at one pitch (A#2, MIDI 46) with 2-second ramps. Faster ramps and the extremes of the range are unprobed; if a wide fan ever sounds wrong, re-run probe 3 at that pitch and rate before assuming the engine is at fault.
glissViability.consequence: M3 (fan) can use the full +/-200 cents per note before needing the segmented re-key strategy. M1 detune bloom (+/-50) and M2 spectral targets (worst case -49 cents for partial 11) sit well inside the clean zone.
